name: restaurante-modelo-tcc
description: Sobe backend (Docker) + painel admin + app do motoboy com um comando so.

scripts.dev: npm run docker:up && npx concurrently -k -n frontend,motoboy -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix motoboy run dev"
scripts.pwa: npm run docker:up && npm run build:all && npx concurrently -k -n frontend,motoboy -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix frontend run preview" "npm --prefix motoboy run preview"
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix motoboy run build
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix motoboy install
